beats.text: East Timor gets 29.4% of its economy from natural gas rents. Qatar gets 12%.
That puts East Timor highest in the world, building nearly a third of its economy on gas.
Qatar, famous for giant energy reserves, gets 12%, giving East Timor 2.4 times its share.
Together, East Timor and Qatar lead global dependence on natural gas rents.
Most global giants sit lower: Russia at 5.9%, the USA 0.4%, China 0.2%, and Zimbabwe 0%.
How much does natural gas power your country's economy?
